content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Jacksonville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years of equivalent experience. Review PMI's official requirements and gather documentation of your role, responsibilities, and hours. Granite PM Academy staff can clarify whether your background meets the credential's standards before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Formal Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend synchronous classes—no recorded playback—taught by active certified practitioners. This structured course covers the PMBOK® Guide, exam domains, and real-world scenarios. Completion earns you the 35 contact hours PMI mandates before you can apply for the credential.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the bootcamp, apply directly to PMI with your education, work history, and contact-hour proof. Pay PMI's exam fee at the same time. PMI will review and approve your application, confirming your eligibility to sit for the exam. Allow time for processing before scheduling your test date.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor support—to reinforce course material. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner. You'll answer questions covering initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, and closing. Pass the exam to earn your PMP® credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP® credential renews every three years. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, or published contributions in project management. Track your PDUs in your PMI account and renew before expiration. Granite PM Academy courses and webinars can count toward your maintenance requirements.
